docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-26-2015 - CONTINUED PER STIPULATION OF ALL PARTIES FOR THE LIMITED PURPOSE OF MEDIATION TO APR-07-2015 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506.
